cssVars: Day cell size and weekday width

propDocs.Calendar.mode: Select one date, multiple dates or a start/end range.
propDocs.Calendar.pageBy: Turn one month or a whole page of months.
propDocs.Calendar.weekStartsOn: First weekday from 0 (Sunday) through 6 (Saturday); omit for locale.
propDocs.Calendar.locale: Locale for month and weekday labels.
propDocs.Calendar.deselectable: Allow pressing a selected single date to clear it.
propDocs.Calendar.minDays: Minimum inclusive span for a range; omit for no additional limit.
